paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Temurah 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Temurah.24a.12): he recited [a tannaitic teaching] before Rav Papa.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Temurah names Rav Shimi bar Ziri reciting a baraita before Rav Pappa. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3301&lang=en) also gives a form with Ze’ira and quotes the full name here.
